explication: blbl-android is a third-party Bilibili Android client for touch and remote-control devices. Its user journey runs from sidebar or startup navigation into discovery, search, live, or account pages; users can open video details and play media with configurable engines and danmaku. The app also provides QR login and playback/settings preferences. The graph combines README-described capabilities with relationships visible in sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX; unsampled feature internals are represented by their exact directories, and uncertain wiring is omitted.
